entries.rationale: Behaviors 2/4/7 give exact signatures, normalization order and tests. Additive exports in one file; the library-module golden sample plus four existing private copies supply the pattern. Only subtlety is byte-compatibility with normalizeRootCause, which Task 6 asserts.

Behaviors 5/5a/5b/6 name all three gates with line numbers. Pattern coverage drops because the adjacent antiPattern/tags precedent uses incoming-wins, the opposite of the required existing-wins rule, so the nearest model is actively misleading. Shared write path, so keep tier full.

Behaviors 1/3/4 plus two error rows fix stdout, stderr and exit codes exactly. Additive dispatch branch in lib/cli/heuristics.mjs following the driver-substrate contract used by 30+ sibling modules. No curated CLI golden sample, hence pattern 3/5.

Behaviors 3a/3b enumerate all four CONFLICTING_SIGNATURE_INPUT cases and the exact expected stdout. Inherited mode hashes nothing, it reuses parseBlockerId's locationHash, so there is no derivation to get wrong. Extends Task 3's skeleton in the same file.

Behavior 7/7a plus the fail-closed error row are explicit; two hook golden samples and runHook cover the pattern. Blast radius held at 4/5 because this is a live Stop hook whose bad output is silent, but it changes future writes only and reverts cleanly. Tier full.

Mechanical delete-and-import refactor across four test-only files, with the test-helpers golden sample as precedent. Spec 4/5 because the byte-identity fixture must be captured BEFORE the refactor, an ordering the agent can silently invert. Tier full for that reason.

Decision layer of a shipped data migration. Spec 3/5: Behavior 8 carries an adjudicated-false claim and _format.md lists three wrong category slugs until Task 9. Four of the last five review blockers lived in this behavior. Pure classifier, no writes, but a wrong prefix set destroys recover ids. Checkpoint after RED.

Only task that mutates persisted data: rewrites 29 live entries across 14 store files, and ships as a verb consumers run against their own untracked stores. Novelty 2/5: merge-then-archive ordering and byte-identical round-trip through serializeHeuristic are unspecified. Blast radius 1 forces oversight.

Four required edits enumerated with line numbers and the correct six slugs supplied verbatim. Documentation plus its existing doc-contract test; no runtime effect. Mirrors the existing Tags Field section and assertion style.
